title: What 2026's best teams actually reached for
title_zh: 2026 年最強的團隊，實際上用了什麼
lede: A census of the computational tools named across every team file in this report — and the one habit that separates the podium from everybody else.
lede_zh: 對本報告所有團隊檔案中提及的運算工具所做的普查——以及把頒獎台和其他人分開的那一個習慣。
body:
Across the team files gathered here, **AlphaFold is still the default**: it is named by roughly a third of teams, more than any other modelling tool, and more than twice as often as the open successors. Boltz appears in a handful of files, ESMFold in a handful more, RFdiffusion and ProteinMPNN in fewer still. The academic literature has already moved past this — open models now match or beat the gated flagship — but iGEM has not caught up. That lag is an opportunity: a team that works fluently with the current open stack is doing something most of the competition is not.

The second pattern is that **the dedicated systems-biology tools have quietly lost**. COPASI, once the standard way an iGEM team built a kinetic model, appears in one file. Tellurium appears in one. MATLAB holds on in four. Everything else is Python — named by more teams than any other single item in the census, usually SciPy integrating an ODE system written by hand. Teaching COPASI as the entry point to modelling now teaches a tool the field has left behind.

The third pattern is the surprise. **Techno-economic analysis — costing the thing, modelling unit economics — is done by more high-school teams than undergraduate teams**, in absolute numbers as well as proportionally. High-school teams are being pushed hard on implementation and business thinking, and they are delivering it. Meanwhile GROMACS, full molecular dynamics, appears exclusively in undergraduate files and never once in a high-school file. The two tiers are not weaker and stronger versions of each other; they are differently shaped.

**Then the finding that matters.** We checked which teams do both halves of modelling properly: fit the model to their own measured data (parameter estimation, regression, R², RMSE, confidence intervals, error bars) *and* validate it against something held back (held-out data, cross-validation, a separate experimental test). Only 14 of 54 teams do both.

Of those 14, **10 are Top 10 teams — 71%**. Of the 42 that do not close that loop, 17 are Top 10 — **40%**. Every one of the four who closed the loop without reaching a Top 10 won a major special prize anyway: XJTLU-China and Jilin-China in Best Model, NJU-China took Best Software & AI Project, Vilnius-Lithuania was nominated in three categories.

This is the single most actionable number in the report. Not which model you use — whether you close the loop between the model and your own data. It is also, conveniently, the cheapest capability to build: it needs no GPU, no licence and no collaboration. It needs a student who knows what a residual is.
body_zh:
在本報告蒐集的團隊檔案中，**AlphaFold 仍然是預設選項**：約三分之一的團隊提到它，比任何其他建模工具都多，也超過開源後繼者的兩倍以上。Boltz 出現在少數幾份檔案，ESMFold 再多一點，RFdiffusion 與 ProteinMPNN 更少。學術文獻早已走過這一步——開源模型現已可匹敵甚至超越封閉的旗艦模型——但 iGEM 還沒跟上。這個時間差就是機會：能熟練運用當前開源工具鏈的團隊，正在做大多數競爭者沒做的事。

第二個型態是，**專用的系統生物學工具已悄悄落敗**。COPASI 曾經是 iGEM 團隊建立動力學模型的標準做法，如今只出現在一份檔案中。Tellurium 一份。MATLAB 勉強守住四份。其餘全是 Python——在整份普查中被提及的團隊數多於任何單一項目，通常是用 SciPy 積分一組手寫的 ODE 系統。現在把 COPASI 當作建模的入門，等於是在教一個領域已經放下的工具。

第三個型態令人意外。**做技術經濟分析——計算成本、建立單位經濟模型——的高中隊伍比大學部隊伍還多**，絕對數與比例皆然。高中組被大力要求落實應用與商業思考，而他們做到了。相對地，完整的分子動力學（GROMACS）只出現在大學部的檔案中，高中組一次也沒有。這兩個層級不是同一件事的強弱版本，它們的形狀本來就不同。

**接著是真正重要的發現。** 我們檢查了哪些團隊把建模的兩半都做完：以自己量到的資料擬合模型（參數估計、回歸、R²、RMSE、信賴區間、誤差棒），*並且*用保留的資料驗證它（held-out 資料、交叉驗證、獨立的實驗測試）。54 支團隊中只有 14 支兩者皆備。

這 14 支裡，**有 10 支是 Top 10 團隊——71%**。而在沒有閉合這個迴圈的 42 支中，只有 17 支進入 Top 10——**40%**。閉合了迴圈卻未進 Top 10 的那四支，無一例外都拿下了重要特別獎：XJTLU-China 與 Jilin-China 在最佳模型，NJU-China 拿下最佳軟體與 AI 專案，Vilnius-Lithuania 則獲三項提名。

這是整份報告中最可執行的一個數字。重點不是你用哪個模型，而是你有沒有把模型與自己的資料之間的迴圈閉合起來。而且它恰好也是最便宜的能力：不需要 GPU、不需要授權、不需要合作對象。它需要的是一位知道什麼叫殘差的學生。

cards.title: 71% versus 40%
cards.body: Teams that both fit their model to their own data and validated it against something held back reached a Top 10 at 71%. Teams that did not reached it at 40%. Note the sample is already decorated — every team here is a Top 10 or special-prize team — so this is loop-closure separating winners from other winners, not from the general field.
cards.body_zh: 既以自身資料擬合模型、又用保留資料加以驗證的團隊，進入 Top 10 的比例是 71%；沒有這麼做的則是 40%。請注意樣本本身已經過篩選——這裡每一支團隊都是 Top 10 或特別獎隊伍——因此這是「閉合迴圈」把贏家從其他贏家中分出來，而不是從一般參賽者中分出來。

cards.title: AlphaFold has not been displaced inside iGEM
cards.title_zh: 在 iGEM 裡，AlphaFold 還沒被取代
cards.body: Roughly a third of teams name AlphaFold, more than twice the rate of Boltz, ESMFold, RFdiffusion or ProteinMPNN. The research literature moved to the open stack over the past year; the competition has not. The teams already working in Boltz and the MPNN family — Lambert-GA, Heidelberg, GU Frankfurt, DTU-Denmark, Princeton — are visibly ahead of the curve rather than merely current.
cards.body_zh: 約三分之一的團隊提到 AlphaFold，是 Boltz、ESMFold、RFdiffusion 或 ProteinMPNN 的兩倍以上。研究文獻在過去一年已轉向開源工具鏈，競賽卻還沒。已經在用 Boltz 與 MPNN 家族的隊伍——Lambert-GA、Heidelberg、GU Frankfurt、DTU-Denmark、Princeton——明顯走在前面，而不只是跟上。

cards.title: Python ate the modelling stack
cards.title_zh: Python 吃掉了整個建模工具鏈
cards.body: COPASI appears once. Tellurium once. MATLAB four times. Python appears in more team files than any other item in the census, usually SciPy integrating a hand-written ODE system, with scikit-learn behind it for anything statistical. For a programme deciding what to teach, this settles the question: teach Python and the numerical stack, and treat SBML-based tools as an interchange format rather than a starting point.
cards.body_zh: COPASI 出現一次，Tellurium 一次，MATLAB 四次。Python 出現在比普查中任何其他項目都多的團隊檔案裡，通常是用 SciPy 積分手寫的 ODE 系統，統計部分則交給 scikit-learn。對一個正在決定要教什麼的課程而言，這已經定案：教 Python 與數值運算工具鏈，把以 SBML 為基礎的工具當作交換格式，而不是起點。

cards.title: High-school teams cost their projects; undergraduates often don't
cards.title_zh: 高中隊伍會算成本，大學部常常不算
cards.body: Techno-economic analysis appears in more high-school files than undergraduate ones, both in absolute count and as a share of the tier. Full molecular dynamics runs the other way and is exclusively undergraduate. The tiers are differently shaped rather than simply further apart, and a high-school programme that assumes it must catch up on everything is aiming at the wrong gap.
cards.body_zh: 技術經濟分析在高中組檔案中出現的次數，無論絕對數或組內占比都高於大學部；完整的分子動力學則完全相反，只出現在大學部。兩個層級的形狀不同，而不只是距離遠近的差別。一個假定自己必須在所有面向上追趕的高中課程，瞄錯了缺口。

cards.title: The cheapest capability is the one that correlates with winning
cards.title_zh: 最便宜的能力，正好就是和得獎相關的那一個
cards.body: Closing the model-data loop needs no GPU, no licence, no partner lab and no new chassis. It needs a student who can fit a curve, report an uncertainty and hold data back for a test. That is a term's teaching, and on this evidence it moves the result more than any tool choice. It is Phase 2 of the roadmap for exactly this reason.
cards.body_zh: 閉合模型與資料之間的迴圈，不需要 GPU、不需要授權、不需要合作實驗室、也不需要新的底盤。它需要的是一位會擬合曲線、會報告不確定度、並且懂得保留資料做測試的學生。那是一個學期的教學量，而根據這些證據，它對結果的影響大於任何工具選擇。這正是它成為路線圖階段二的原因。

method: Counts come from pattern-matching the `dry` and `good` fields of every team file in this report, not from reading the wikis a second time, so a technique a team used but did not write up is invisible here. The sample is decorated teams only — every file is a Top 10 or special-prize winner or nominee — so the baselines are not the whole competition. The loop-closure test looks for explicit language about fitting, uncertainty and validation; a team that did the work but described it loosely will be undercounted. Read the numbers as a ranking, not a measurement.
method_zh: 計數方式是對本報告每一份團隊檔案的 `dry` 與 `good` 欄位做樣式比對，而非重新閱讀 wiki，因此團隊做了卻沒寫下來的技術在這裡是看不見的。樣本僅限獲獎隊伍——每一份檔案都是 Top 10 或特別獎得主／入圍者——所以基準值並不代表整個競賽。迴圈閉合的判準是尋找明確描述擬合、不確定度與驗證的文字；做了卻寫得含糊的團隊會被低估。請把這些數字當成排序，而不是量測。
